# aurum-demo

A synthetic project used only as a review target by the AurumCode demo office.

Nothing in this tree was copied from a real repository, and no value in it is
a working credential. The history is rebuilt byte for byte from
`history.spec` and this `content/` overlay by `build-fixture.sh`.

## Layout

- `config/app.yaml` - service configuration for the demo run.
- `src/greeter.py` - the single behavior the demo review reasons about.
- `config/demo-tokens.txt` - deliberately planted synthetic tokens.
